layerPanel.title: Layers
layerPanel.newVectorLayerTitle: New vector layer (editable shapes, text and paths)
layerPanel.nothingToFlattenToast: Nothing to flatten — there's already just one layer
layerPanel.flattenTitle: Flatten image — merges ALL layers (even hidden ones) into one, discarding what's hidden
layerPanel.scenesDescription: Saves a snapshot of which layers are visible, their opacity, blend mode, effects, and the canvas zoom/position — to jump between different versions or framings of the project.

layerItem.isolatedTitle: Isolated — Alt+click to restore the rest
layerItem.isolateTitle: Alt+click to isolate (show only this layer)
layerItem.alphaLockedTitle: Transparency locked — paint only over existing pixels
layerItem.linkedInstanceTitle: Create linked instance (shares content, independent styling)
layerItem.invertColorsTitle: Invert colors (Ctrl+I) — destructive; for a non-destructive adjustment, use an adjustment layer
layerItem.desaturateTitle: Desaturate (Ctrl+Shift+U) — destructive; for a non-destructive adjustment, use an adjustment layer

vectorObjectsEditor.rasterizeTitle: Convert to pixel layer (individual objects can no longer be edited)
vectorObjectsEditor.emptyHint: Draw shapes, text or pen paths on this layer: each one becomes an editable object. Use the "Select object" tool to move them.

toolOptions.warpHint: Paint over the canvas to deform the pixels live — "Push" drags in the direction of the stroke.
toolOptions.magicWandHint: Click on the canvas to select the connected area of similar color.
toolOptions.gradientHintRadial: Drag from the center outward — primary color in the center, secondary at the edge.
toolOptions.gradientHintLinear: Drag over the canvas to define the gradient axis — primary color at the start, secondary at the end. Hold Shift to snap to 45°.
toolOptions.eyedropperAverageHint: Averaging the area avoids picking up a "weird" color on anti-aliased edges or textures.
toolOptions.lassoHint: Drag to draw the selection outline — it closes automatically on release.
toolOptions.flowTitle: Amount of paint per stamp. With flow enabled, opacity becomes the cap for the whole stroke.
toolOptions.sampleAllLayers: Detect the area across all layers
toolOptions.fillHint: Meant for coloring line art: turn on "all layers", color on a layer below the drawing, and raise "Close gaps" if the outline has small openings.
toolOptions.smudgeHint: Drag over the canvas to blend colors like wet paint. With "Color load" it gradually adds the primary color while you blend.

shapeToolOptions.textHint: Click on the canvas and type — Enter confirms the typed text.
shapeToolOptions.saveAsShapeATitle: Saves this shape to combine it with the next one
shapeToolOptions.shapeASaved: Shape A saved — draw a second shape and choose how to combine them:
shapeToolOptions.divideTitle: Splits the A-only, B-only and intersection areas into separate layers

selectionModifiers.selectPrimaryTitle: Selects every pixel of the primary color anywhere on the layer, not just the contiguous area
selectionModifiers.selectPrimary: Select primary color across the whole layer
